water.name: Ocean
water.rule: Sea more than 200 m deep and away from land (ETOPO/terrarium bathymetry).

water.name: Coast
water.rule: Sea shallower than 200 m, or touching land.

water.name: Lake
water.rule: Hex centre inside a Natural Earth lake.

relief.name: Flat
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation inside the hex under 60 m.

relief.name: Peaks
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation over 450 m, or mean elevation over 2,500 m.

notes.land: A hex is land when at least 7 of its 13 sample points fall inside a Natural Earth 1:50m country polygon.
notes.cover: Cover comes from the 1976-2000 Koppen-Geiger climate polygons (Beck et al.), mapped to the six biome groups the map draws, then cropland and pasture are carved out of each country's World Bank arable and permanent-pasture hectares on the most suitable hexes, and Natural Earth urban areas override forest or grass where a city stands.
notes.elev: Mean elevation from the Mapzen/Terrain Tiles terrarium set (z4, ~10 km pixels), bilinear-sampled at 13 points per hex; ocean cells carry the bathymetry value.
notes.rivers: Natural Earth 1:50m rivers and lake centrelines, simplified to 1 point per 25 km.
